plugin.lede: Third-party extensions add tools, screens, report sources and automation actions to TILL. Each runs sandboxed with only the permissions you grant, and none can open a second path to your ledger.

Extensions.title: Extensions
Extensions.body: Extensions shows which plugins are installed in this workspace and what each one is allowed to do. Before any install you review the requested permissions and decide yourself. A plugin gets only the permissions you see and confirm at install; its screens run in an isolated frame and talk to TILL only through defined interfaces.
